# cpanel_redirect (Data Source)

Looks up one cPanel HTTP redirect rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_redirect" "legacy" {
  domain = "example.com"
  source = "/old"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The cPanel account domain that owns the redirect.
- `source` (String) The absolute source URL path.

### Read-Only

- `destination` (String) The absolute HTTP or HTTPS destination URL.
- `document_root` (String) The absolute document root whose `.htaccess` file contains the redirect.
- `kind` (String) The redirect directive kind reported by cPanel.
- `status_code` (Number) The HTTP status code reported by cPanel.
- `type` (String) Whether the redirect is `permanent` (`301`) or `temporary` (`302`).
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether matching files below the source path keep their relative path below the destination.
- `www_mode` (String) Whether the redirect matches `both` www and non-www requests, or only requests `without` www.
